      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add unit tests exercising combinations of SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_CAT and SCRIPT_VERIFY_OP_CAT",
      "quote": "it would be great to have a test that exercises the combinations of SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_CAT and SCRIPT_VERIFY_OP_CAT",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "tests added to script_tests.json",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:1763450844",
      "status_by_quote": "Added some additional unit tests to script_tests.json testing different combinations of scripts with and without (SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_CAT, SCRIPT_VERIFY_OP_CAT and SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_SUCCESS)"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2424200438",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "merging a consensus opcode change without project or community consensus",
      "quote": "there does not appear to be consensus for the concept of OP_CAT in TapScript yet, so this PR cannot be merged even if the code is okay.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "draft status remains; consensus has not formed",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": ["c:2425013338"],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2857183685",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "whether the case where SCRIPT_VERIFY_OP_CAT = False and SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_CAT = False is part of the tests and soft fork table",
      "quote": "What about SCRIPT_VERIFY OP_CAT = False and SCRIPT_VERIFY DISCOURAGE_OP_CAT = False? This combination is not described in the \"soft fork\" table. Is it part of the tests?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "answered by EthanHeilman, arminsabouri, and ajtowns",
      "author_replies": ["c:2864936156"],
      "other_replies": ["c:2860437712", "c:2863344633", "c:2873037419"],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:2864936156",
      "status_by_quote": "That said, @AlexSQY, you're right -- this edge case deserves documentation. If I recall correctly, it’s being tested here"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:4353114242",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "I am still very interested in merging this, however there was unexpected progress in quantum computers and I am temporarily shifting my attention to that.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "decision",
      "what": "project and community consensus on OP_CAT in Tapscript",

  "notes": "Re-evaluated under current schema: converted rot13maxi's rc:1757499656 to a suggestion since it requested additional test coverage rather than naming an unavoidable harm; added Co1nB3e's question c:2857183685; awin28522's approval remains unlisted in support as an empty verdict with no project history rationale."
}
